PCM-D-13 RESOLVED 2026-08-28 (Price): keep missing as missing. Y maps to Y; blank is NOT converted to N. Both columns are Y-or-blank with no explicit N anywhere, and the dictionary says only 'Has ICD code for X' -- so a blank means no ICD code was found, which is not the same as the condition being absent. Mapping blank to N would assert something the data never says. The harmonized column is therefore Y-or-blank, and any analyst treating blank as absent does so knowingly in their own code.
